brief: Goldman's weekly PT/credit note (Ethan Polley, 10 Oct 2026) describes a volatile week: rate volatility at 6-month highs and stocks near all-time highs. A 10y reopening and 30y auction both cleared with support. Trump's announced suspension of attacks on Iran pushed stocks higher. In Europe, France deficit concerns triggered an initial flight-to-quality that stabilized, leaving Xover 2bps tighter and the 10y OAT/Bund spread at +137.5bps. In US credit, cash decompression pushed the HYG-3xLQD spread to its widest since May, with HY PT flow 2.4:1 BB buyers versus 1.4:1 CCC buyers ($2.09bn vs $53mm net notional). In IG, chip-financing deal reports plus weaker-than-expected OpenAI revenue headlines widened beta hyperscaler names, pushing the GS IG 30y Hyperscaler vs ex-hyperscaler basket spread to its widest since July (+7.4bps WoW). The PT desk fielded $28.1bn in inquiry; IG was a net client-selling market by dv01 even as IG100 cash tightened 3bps on macro strength rather than fundamentals, while HY stayed firm with BB-concentrated buying against single-B-heavy BWICs and wider bid-offer.
